note: An authored SCB variant (#1855) under exported register 1: people has no Registerinformation row. Two declared editions (2022, 2023), a donor-delivered VALUE from addresses with donor_coding, and a holdings_period mint PID that is its panel entity key.
fails_if: an authored variant gets no naming binding or declared variant, so people forms nothing; the errata loop refuses it with 'no native variant records'; the delivered addition stops copying the donor's coding at the same edition (2022 loses code 01) or copies it into an edition the donor does not document (2023 gains it); the holdings mint lands on another variant; or the authored variant's support captures one record of its two-record anchor, so the delivered entry is stale (support_projection_changed)

sources.description: Register 1, variant 2 documents VALUE (variable 5, CVID 101) in 2022 with code list 01 One, beside LABEL (variable 4, CVID 100), exported under two object types: the register's least ref, which anchors people, is two records.
